U3500.title: Control Module Input Power A Circuit Range/Performance
U3500.description: Control Module Input Power A Circuit Range/Performance: the signal is implausible or outside the valid range.

causes.label: High resistance in supply path
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly
CAN terminating resistor (120 Ω) drifted out of spec

symptoms: Multiple warning lights may illuminate
Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module
Diagnostic tools may show communication faults

U3511.title: High Voltage System Interlock Circuit B
U3511.description: Generic fault on the second high-voltage interlock loop (HVIL) circuit. The interlock detects whether HV connectors are properly mated; an open loop forces the HV system into a safe state.

causes.label: HV connector not fully mated
Interlock pilot pin damaged
Damaged interlock wiring or corroded terminal in the loop
Fault in the module that drives and evaluates the interlock loop

symptoms: Vehicle will not switch to ready mode or the HV system shuts down
High-voltage system warning in the instrument cluster
Charging may be blocked

U3512.title: High Voltage System Interlock Circuit B Performance
U3512.description: HVIL loop B is electrically OK but timing/pattern does not match expected behavior — possibly intermittent contact in a connector.

causes.label: Intermittent contact in HV connector
HV connector, service disconnect or cover switch not fully seated
Damaged interlock wiring or corroded terminal in the loop
Fault in the module that drives and evaluates the interlock loop

symptoms: Vehicle will not switch to ready mode or the HV system shuts down
High-voltage system warning in the instrument cluster
Charging may be blocked

U3513.title: High Voltage System Interlock Circuit B Low
U3513.description: HVIL loop B voltage below expected range — short to ground in the interlock wiring. The interlock is a low-voltage signal loop routed through the HV connectors and covers; the monitoring module drives a current or signal through it and opens the HV contactors, or refuses to close them, when the loop is broken or out of range, so that no HV connection can be opened while live.

causes.label: Interlock wire shorted to ground
HV connector, service disconnect or cover switch not fully seated
Damaged interlock wiring or corroded terminal in the loop
Fault in the module that drives and evaluates the interlock loop

symptoms: Vehicle will not switch to ready mode or the HV system shuts down
High-voltage system warning in the instrument cluster
Charging may be blocked
